name: Belize

fees.name: Single entry visa (all other nationals)
fees.applies: all nationalities requiring a visa, except China and India/Nepal/Thailand/Burma/Bangladesh/Pakistan/Sri Lanka schedules
fees.notes: Fee schedule effective 1 May 2020. BZD pegged 2:1 to USD. Exemption: US permanent residents or holders of a valid US visitor visa do not need a Belize visa.

fees.name: Multiple entry visa (all other nationals)
fees.applies: all nationalities requiring a visa, except China and India/Nepal/Thailand/Burma/Bangladesh/Pakistan/Sri Lanka schedules

fees.name: Belize eVisa
fees.notes: Official eVisa portal exists (evisa.immigration.gov.bz) but was unreachable at research time and no fee is published on immigration.gov.bz; fee unverified, recorded as null.

reciprocity_variations.note: Single entry BZD 3,000; multiple entry BZD 4,000 (People's Republic of China nationals).
Single entry BZD 750; multiple entry BZD 1,000 (India, Nepal, Thailand, Burma/Myanmar, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Sri Lanka).

free_visa_notes: Many nationalities (e.g. USA, GBR, CAN, EU, CARICOM) are visa-exempt for tourist stays. Holders of a valid US visitor visa or US permanent residence are exempt from Belize visa requirements. No visa-on-arrival or eTA regime found on official sources; no separate business or transit visa fee is published (the single/multiple entry visa schedule applies).
